description: Language-neutral vectors for the two pure functions of the current adapter: interpretImportResult(result) and classifyError(error, uploadStarted). The Kotlin client must reproduce these dispositions exactly (state, kind, message). Messages are fixed, safe strings: provider text, tokens and URLs never leak into them.

rules: If result is not a JSON object => unknown/response 'Garmin returned an unrecognized import response.'
detail = result.detailedImportResult if it is an object, else result itself.
If detail.failures is a non-empty array: lower-case its compact JSON; contains 'duplicate' or 'already exists' => failed/duplicate, else failed/rejected.

If detail.successes is not a non-empty array whose first element is an object: if lower(trim(detail.status)) in {uploaded, success, succeeded, completed} => confirmed (no remoteId), else unknown/response 'Garmin did not provide explicit import confirmation.'

remoteId = successes[0].activityId, else successes[0].internalId. Missing or blank => unknown/response 'Garmin confirmed an import item without an activity identifier.' Otherwise confirmed with remoteId as a string.

expected.message: Garmin reports that this activity already exists.

rules: Evaluated in this order on (exception type name, exception message):
1. dependency missing (Python ModuleNotFoundError; Kotlin: client module unavailable / feature flag off) => failed/provider-unavailable 'The unsupported Garmin adapter dependency is not installed.'
2. type name contains 'Authentication' or 'MFA', or message contains '401' or '403' => failed/authentication 'Garmin authentication was rejected or expired.'
3. type name contains 'TooManyRequests' or message contains '429' => failed/rate-limit 'Garmin rate-limited the request.'
4. message contains '409' or lower(message) contains 'duplicate' => failed/duplicate 'Garmin reports that this activity already exists.'
5. uploadStarted => unknown/transport 'The Garmin response was interrupted after upload began.'
6. otherwise => failed/provider 'The unsupported Garmin provider rejected the operation.'
uploadStarted is true only inside the upload (import) and delete calls, after the call was issued. Login, search and download errors always use uploadStarted=false.
